patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: (Dad) She got into my shoebox and chewed one of those little 'DO NOT EAT' packets. She's totally fine — running around, ate lunch — but I panicked. Is it poison?
presentation.triageNote: 3-year-old female, ingested part of a silica-gel desiccant packet, completely asymptomatic, eating and drinking normally, with an unremarkable exam.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: Discharge is appropriate because the confirmed exposure is generally nontoxic and the asymptomatic child is not expected to need an emergency treatment-area resource.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This is an asymptomatic child after chewing a silica-gel packet who remains playful and is eating and drinking normally.
clinical.acuityReason: There are no airway symptoms, vomiting, drooling, altered behavior, pain, abnormal vital signs, or other evidence of toxicity.
expectedResources: Product confirmation and brief ingestion assessment
teachingPoints: Silica gel is generally considered nontoxic, although the packet can still present a choking risk.
The exact product matters because button batteries, magnets, medications, and caustic substances require different responses.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: After confirming the product and a reassuring assessment, the child could be discharged with poison-information guidance and return precautions for airway or gastrointestinal symptoms.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: wiggly, half-standing by the clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. ANATOMY AND OBJECTS (critical): exactly one head, exactly two arms ending in exactly two hands, exactly two legs ending in two feet, five fingers on each hand. No extra, duplicated, floating or partial limbs anywhere. Anything the character touches must be plausibly held by one of those two hands. All furniture is solid and fully opaque - the chair must never look transparent or see-through, and its back, seat and legs must all be completely drawn. Subject: an asian 3-year-old girl, playful and healthy, beside a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: wiggly, half-standing, full of energy. Expression: happy and oblivious. Clearly visible: a lively, completely well-looking child with no signs of distress. No text, no logos.
